about: Parametric potion bottle shared by Tools/process_art.py (draws the glass sprites) and Scripts/Game/Board/BottleShape.cs (pours the liquid). Shape units: the inner body width is 1.0; y = 0 is the inner bottom, y grows upward; x = 0 is the vertical axis. The 'sprite' block is (re)written by process_art.py.
